turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’m coming in because I feel slightly dizzy or lightheaded. I also have symptoms that get worse with physical exertion and improve with rest.
What specific symptoms get worse with physical exertion and improve with rest? For example, do you experience chest pain, shortness of breath, or a fast heart rate?
Yes—when I exert myself, I feel worse, and when I rest I improve. I also have a fast, irregular heartbeat with palpitations, and I’ve had a heart attack or angina (chest pain).
Are you currently experiencing any chest pain, pressure, or shortness of breath?

I don’t know. I do have a fast, irregular heartbeat with palpitations, and my symptoms get worse with physical exertion but improve with rest. I also have severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), diabetes, and a known heart defect, and I’ve had a heart attack or angina (chest pain).
